workbook_workflow.generator: scripts/build_workbooks.py (--only screening); one copy per reviewer, generated from this template, fulltext_exclusion_codes.json, screening_manual.md, calibration_plan.md and 03_search/search_log_template.json
workbook_workflow.merge_and_agreement: scripts/merge_screening.py merge --stage TI|TA|FT (TA with --population merged_TI.csv, FT with --population merged_TA.csv); prisma for flow counts
workbook_workflow.independence_rule: Each reviewer decides only in their own workbook and locks it; the SHA-256 of each locked workbook is recorded here and committed to git before any merge; reviewers do not see each other's decisions before both are locked. No AI hint, recommended option or pre-classification is shown to reviewers at title (TI), title/abstract (TA) or full-text (FT) screening (v3.1).
workbook_workflow.exports: CSV exports of reviewer sheets and merge outputs are versioned in git; no Rayyan/Covidence.
workbook_workflow.AI_role: AI may prepare, transform, check and summarise; it never decides eligibility or acts as reviewer/adjudicator.
workbook_workflow.stage_workbooks: v3.1 (PRE-005): stage 1 uses a workbook whose records_master holds the whole deduplicated pool WITHOUT abstracts (abstract column left empty; reviewers decide in screen_TI_reviewer_A/B). Stage 2 uses a fresh workbook generated from the same templates whose records_master holds only the stage-1 retained records (final TI disposition ADVANCE_TO_ABSTRACT or AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION) with completed abstracts and abstract_source filled.

title_calibration.sampling_frame: Deduplicated union of the formal database exports (PubMed, Web of Science Core Collection, Scopus; amendment PRE-006) (records_master rows with a blank dedup_status), frozen and hashed before sampling

pass_rule.sampling: random without replacement from the sorted frozen deduplicated union
pass_rule.agreement_metric: raw agreement on the binary TI disposition
pass_rule.disagreement_handling: Every disagreement (disposition or closed-list code) is discussed and logged with any manual clarification; the pass rule is the raw-agreement threshold only (A, 2026-10-05).
pass_rule.kappa: Cohen's kappa reported descriptively; no pass threshold

title_calibration.timing: After the formal searches and deduplication and before formal stage-1 title screening; protocol v3.1 must be released first.
title_calibration.repeat_seed_rule: seed = 20261005 + round_number - 1; first repeat round_number=2; exclude all IDs sampled in earlier rounds
title_calibration.pilot_records_rule: Pilot records stay in the formal stage-1 pool and are screened again under the final manual; pilot decisions are calibration only.

pass_rule.sampling: random without replacement from the sorted frozen deduplicated draft pool
pass_rule.agreement_metric: raw agreement on the binary TA disposition
pass_rule.kappa: Cohen's kappa reported descriptively; no pass threshold
pass_rule.source: 04_screening/calibration_plan.md (human-readable rule; the generator parses the threshold and binary groups from that file, so both must agree)

calibration.timing: After the v3.0 archive release (GitHub Release + Zenodo version DOI) and before the formal search; if the pilot changes rules, release v3.1 with justification.
concept_comparison_items: Core A identifiable bout and post-cessation timing
Support B same marker, same people, >= 2 identified bouts
position relative to the 0-72 h organising window (outside-window samples tagged, not excluded)
adult >= 18 y or separable adult stratum
author open-window framing does not affect eligibility
calibration.repeat_seed_rule: seed = 20261002 + round_number - 1; first repeat round_number=2; exclude all IDs sampled in earlier rounds
calibration.manual_version_rule: Record the screening_manual.md version as the protocol release tag plus git commit SHA used to generate the workbooks.
calibration.pilot_2026-10-05_mode: Decisions entered by reviewers B and C through the coordinator's AskUserQuestion interface, one reviewer at a time with the other away from the screen; an AI-generated hint (recommended option) was visible for every record; recorded as AI-assisted calibration in ai_use_log.json

result_2026-10-05.limitation: AI hint visible to both reviewers; acceptance pending A
result_2026-10-05.acceptance: accepted by A 2026-10-05 as calibration; limitation (visible AI hint) recorded; formal screening without AI hints

recalibration_v3_1.reason: The 50-record TA pilot (round 1, 2026-10-05) was run under v3.0 codes; v3.1 changes the screening codes (TI stage, RETAIN_BACKGROUND, age rule), so a reduced TA re-calibration is required before formal stage 2.
recalibration_v3_1.seed_basis: repeat_seed_rule of this calibration block (20261002 + round_number - 1)
recalibration_v3_1.sampling_frame: Sorted stage-1 retained set (final TI disposition ADVANCE_TO_ABSTRACT or AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION) after abstract completion, excluding any ID sampled in earlier rounds
recalibration_v3_1.pass_rule: Same as calibration.pass_rule (raw agreement >= 0.80 on the binary TA disposition and every conceptual disagreement resolved; kappa descriptive), applied to 25 records
recalibration_v3_1.timing: After abstract completion and before formal stage-2 title/abstract screening.

abstract_completion.applies_to: Records whose final TI disposition is ADVANCE_TO_ABSTRACT or AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION (the stage-1 retained set)
abstract_completion.timing: After both TI workbooks are locked and merged; before the stage-2 re-calibration and formal stage 2. Abstracts are not shown to reviewers at stage 1.

source_priorities.description: Abstract already contained in a database export of the record (PubMed MEDLINE/XML export; Web of Science full-record export; any other export that includes it).
PubMed record retrieved by PMID, or by DOI converted to PMID with the NCBI ID Converter.
Full-record retrieval from the source database: Scopus COMPLETE view where entitled; Web of Science full record (Embase and SPORTDiscus withdrawn under PRE-006).
Manual request list for A, fulltext_requests/abstract_requests.csv (same pattern as fulltext_requests.csv): A obtains the abstract through institutional access and D records it.

abstract_completion.abstract_unavailable_rule: A record for which no abstract is obtainable after ranks 1-4 is screened at stage 2 on its title and any other available text and recorded as abstract_unavailable in records_master.abstract_source. A missing abstract is never an exclusion reason.
abstract_completion.record_rule: The first source in rank order that yields an abstract is recorded in records_master.abstract_source; the abstract text is pasted unchanged into records_master.abstract. Retrieval attempts that fail are logged in the workbook log sheet.
abstract_completion.performed_by: D (data manager); A for manual requests

field_schema.record_id: Stable unique report identifier from the deduplicated formal-search pool.
field_schema.report_id: Bibliographic report identifier; link versions and related reports.
field_schema.cohort_id: Participant cohort identifier; used to prevent double counting.
field_schema.preprint_linked_publication_id: Record identifier for version linkage, if applicable.
field_schema.title: Record title as exported (records_master.title).
field_schema.doi: DOI exactly as exported; text, no URL prefix (records_master.doi).
field_schema.pmid: PubMed ID; text, leading zeros preserved (records_master.pmid).
field_schema.source_database: Database/platform from search_log_template.searches[].database, or the documented supplemental route; several separated by "; " (records_master.source_database).
field_schema.search_id: search_log_template.searches[].id of the export(s) containing the record (records_master.search_id).
field_schema.route: search_log_template route: E AND I (the single route under amendment PRE-006; E AND O appears only in superseded v0.7 artefacts), or the supplemental route label, e.g. the Google Scholar string ID (records_master.route).
field_schema.dedup_status: One of dedup_status_values; in the Excel records_master a blank dedup_status cell means RETAINED.
field_schema.document_type: Document/publication type exactly as exported (PubMed publication type, Web of Science/Scopus document type); several sources separated by "; "; shown to reviewers at title screening (records_master.document_type).
field_schema.abstract_source: abstract_completion.source_values code for how records_master.abstract was obtained (database_export, pubmed_pmid_or_doi, source_full_record, manual_request) or abstract_unavailable; blank until abstract completion (records_master.abstract_source).

conditional.healthy_stratum_extractable_if_mixed: Required only when the cohort mixes healthy and clinical participants.
conditional.adult_or_separable_adult_stratum: TRUE when all participants are >= 18 y or an adult stratum and its results are separable, judged by the age rule: explicit age range/minimum >= 18 y, or mean - 2*SD >= 18 y. UNCLEAR (record AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION) when the rule cannot be met and the report does not state that participants < 18 y were included. FALSE (FT03) only when < 18 y participation is stated and no adult stratum with results is separable.

tagging_only_not_eligibility.post_cessation_sample_within_window: TRUE if at least one post-cessation sample falls within 0-72 h after cessation of the identifiable bout. FALSE (only samples > 72 h) does NOT exclude: the record stays eligible and its samples are tagged outside-window recovery (contract 2.2; no exclusion code).

eligibility_check_semantics.no_intensity_check: No exposure-intensity, duration or mode eligibility check exists (contract 2.1); use exposure_as_reported to record them.

exposure_as_reported.rule: Recording only; never an eligibility criterion. Full values are charted at extraction (sample_sets).

screening_disposition_stage_notes.TI: Title screening (stage 1; v3.1, PRE-005): must equal the bold dispositions in screening_manual.md section A', from which scripts/build_workbooks.py derives the TI dropdown. Reviewers see title, source/journal, year, document type, DOI and PMID only. EXCLUDE_TITLE requires one title_stage_primary_reason_codes code; consensus is automatic (title_stage_rules).
screening_disposition_stage_notes.TA: Title/abstract dispositions (stage 2; records retained at TI); must equal the bold dispositions in screening_manual.md section 3B, from which scripts/build_workbooks.py derives the TA dropdown.
screening_disposition_stage_notes.FT: Full-text dispositions; administrative statuses (DUPLICATE_*, NOT_RETRIEVED, AWAITING_*, FRONTIER_PREPRINT, RETAIN_BACKGROUND) take no FT code. RETAIN_BACKGROUND (v3.1) is full-text only and maps to scope_stream background.
screening_disposition_stage_notes.DEDUP: Record preparation (records_master.dedup_status). A duplicate/version recognised later may also be recorded at FT.

dedup_status_values.RETAINED: Unique record, or the retained member of a duplicate/version group; screened. Not a disposition and not an administrative exclusion status. Entered as a blank dedup_status cell in the Excel records_master.
dedup_status_values.DUPLICATE_RECORD: Exact bibliographic duplicate of a retained record (fulltext_exclusion_codes.json administrative status).
dedup_status_values.DUPLICATE_VERSION: Superseded version (for example preprint vs publication) of a retained report (fulltext_exclusion_codes.json administrative status).

title_stage_primary_reason_codes.rule: EXCLUDE_TITLE records exactly one code from this closed list (first evident reason in list order, which follows the FT hierarchy); null for ADVANCE_TO_ABSTRACT and AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION.

title_stage_rules.consensus_rule: Advance wins: if either reviewer chose ADVANCE_TO_ABSTRACT the final disposition is ADVANCE_TO_ABSTRACT; EXCLUDE_TITLE only when both chose EXCLUDE_TITLE (final_primary_reason = the earlier of the two codes in closed-list order); any other complete pair is AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION. No adjudication at this stage.
title_stage_rules.conflict_logging: A conflict is a different disposition, or two EXCLUDE_TITLE decisions with different codes; conflicts are counted and listed (merge_TI, conflicts_TI.csv) but not adjudicated.
title_stage_rules.next_stage: ADVANCE_TO_ABSTRACT and AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION records go to abstract completion and stage 2 (TA); EXCLUDE_TITLE records leave the flow with their closed-list code.

field_schema.title_abstract_primary_reason_codes: At stage 2, EXCLUDE_TA primary_reason uses the FT01-FT08 codes from fulltext_exclusion_codes.json (first clearly failed dimension in hierarchy order); there are no separate TA codes. Null for every other TA disposition.

A_B_eligible_allowed_values.note: TRUE/FALSE are the JSON booleans true/false; NR/NA/UNCLEAR follow 05_extraction/data_dictionary.json missing_value_semantics. Scope labels used downstream: A_core_acute, B_support_repeated_bouts, background, excluded, uncertain (contract 8.3g). RETAIN_BACKGROUND records A_eligible = FALSE and B_eligible = FALSE.

record_validation_rules: Field schema describes a blank future record; records remains empty until actual screening.
Two human reviewer decisions are stored independently and locked before reconciliation; AI cannot populate an independent reviewer decision.
Scientific EXCLUDE_FT requires exactly one first-established FT01–FT08 code; administrative statuses require null primary exclusion codes.
EXCLUDE_TA requires exactly one primary_reason from FT01-FT08 (first clearly failed dimension); other TA dispositions require a null primary_reason.
INCLUDE_B or INCLUDE_A_AND_B requires source evidence for same immune marker, same individuals, >=2 identifiable bouts, post-cessation timing and baseline/comparator.
Keep retrieval, translation, publication/version and eligibility states separately; missing information is not an established exclusion.
Pilot records count formally only if identified through documented formal search/citation chasing; pilot_rounds stores actual results only.
NR = not reported; NA = inapplicable; UNCLEAR = genuinely ambiguous. Null fields here are unpopulated template values, not negative findings.

Participants < 18 y (stated in the report), or a mixed-age cohort with stated < 18 y participants and no separable adult stratum, establish FT03; adult status follows the age rule (explicit range/minimum >= 18 y or mean - 2*SD >= 18 y); otherwise AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION. Older adults are eligible and flagged as a subgroup.
There is no exposure-intensity, duration or mode eligibility check; exposure_as_reported is recording only.
post_cessation_sample_within_window = FALSE (only samples > 72 h) never establishes an exclusion; samples are tagged outside-window recovery. FT05 applies only to during-only sampling.
Use of the term 'open window' or the authors' stance on it never affects eligibility.
Each reviewer's locked workbook SHA-256 is recorded in workbook_workflow.locks (and calibration.reviewer_workbook_sha256 for the pilot) and committed to git before merge_screening.py is run.

RETAIN_BACKGROUND (v3.1) is an administrative full-text disposition: null primary exclusion code, the failed dimension (normally FT04) in secondary_failed_dimensions, A_eligible and B_eligible FALSE; allowed only for original, generally healthy adult human studies with an eligible immune link whose only failure is a background exposure/timing pattern.

A related version (preprint, accepted manuscript) of a retained peer-reviewed report is DUPLICATE_VERSION with retained_record_id; it is charted only as a version stub (bibliographic and version fields; scope NA). FRONTIER_PREPRINT is used only when no peer-reviewed version exists at the final update.

Title screening (TI, v3.1 PRE-005): EXCLUDE_TITLE requires exactly one title_stage_primary_reason_codes code; ADVANCE_TO_ABSTRACT and AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION require a null primary_reason. Only the closed-list reasons in fulltext_exclusion_codes.json title_stage_closed_list may exclude at TI; anything else is ADVANCE_TO_ABSTRACT.
TI consensus is automatic (title_stage_rules.consensus_rule: any ADVANCE_TO_ABSTRACT wins; EXCLUDE_TITLE only when both reviewers chose it); conflicts are logged, not adjudicated.

Stage 2 (TA) screens exactly the stage-1 retained set; a record without an obtainable abstract is screened on its title and available text with abstract_source = abstract_unavailable and is never excluded for that reason.
